summary: Full end-to-end validation of Euler EV-dealership CRM. Backend: 29/30 pytest tests passed (1 skipped because seeded leads carry no discounts, so no OEM claims are derivable to settle — expected per problem statement). Frontend: 27/27 UI checks passed — dashboard KPIs, all 13 sidebar nav pages, Lead Register (12 rows), search, Lead 360 drawer with all 6 tabs, Save Price / Save Scheme / Add Payment / Convert-to-Booking / Save Quote flows all functional. Commercial engine math validated: Gross = sum of charges, OEM-eligible = consumer+exchange+loyalty+referral+dsa, Dealer = additional, Customer Payable correctly reduces by passed benefits + exchange. Finance-mode payment auto-creates a Finance Register file. Delivery=Yes flips lead to Delivered. Close sets accountStatus=Closed.

issues: Clean SaaS-light layout, KPI cards + bar chart + model performance table all render correctly with INR formatting. No contrast or spacing issues observed.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~745 lines — approaching the 700-line guidance limit. Consider splitting into routers/leads.py, routers/dashboard.py, routers/masters.py, routers/quotations.py for maintainability.

GET /api/claims re-derives per-lead on every call by scanning all booked leads and issuing find_one() for each component — O(N*M) DB round trips. Cache or pre-materialise on lead update if lead volume grows.
recompute_lead runs on every price/scheme/payment mutation and does its own aggregate — fine at current scale, but consider batching if bulk updates are added later.
No pagination on /api/leads (to_list(3000)) or /api/payments (2000) — acceptable for current dataset size; add limit/offset for production.
CORS is wide-open (allow_origins=['*']) with allow_credentials=True — acceptable for the shared-view use case but flag if auth is ever added.
test_credentials: N/A — single shared view, no auth
seed_data_creation: Backend journey test created TEST_-prefixed lead (LD26000012) and TEST_Auto Lead (LD26000011). UI test converted LD26000005 to Booked and added a payment. These are safe test records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_euler_crm.py — 30 tests, run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_euler_crm.py. All /api routes covered: dashboard, leads CRUD + 360, price-structure, scheme, payments (with finance auto-file), delivery, close, commercial/compute, quotations, claims, all master/register endpoints. Test data created: LD26000011 (TEST_Auto Lead, New), LD26000012 (TEST_Journey, Delivered->Closed). UI touched LD26000005 (now Booked with a scheme/price applied).
